# Support

This project is maintained by a single person in their spare time. To
keep issue traffic useful for everyone, please match your question to the
right channel.

## Where to ask

| If you want to … | Go to |
| --- | --- |
| Report a bug | [GitHub Issues](../../issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) — fill in OS, deployment method, version, architecture, and paste actual logs (not paraphrases) |
| Request a feature | [GitHub Issues](../../issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) — see [GOVERNANCE.md](./GOVERNANCE.md) for the alignment check |
| Ask "how do I …" | [GitHub Discussions](../../discussions) → Q&A — questions are not bugs; opening them as issues crowds out real bug reports |
| Report a security vulnerability | **Do not file a public issue.** Email `hancic128+security@proton.me` — see [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) for the full process |
| Report a code-of-conduct violation | Email `hancic128+conduct@proton.me` — see [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) |

## What to expect

- **Initial response**: a maintainer comment within a few days. The
  project is single-maintainer, so there are no SLAs
- **Triage**: bug reports are confirmed against `main` before any fix
  work begins. Feature requests are evaluated against the project's
  single-operator, multi-machine-management scope — out-of-scope items
  will be closed with a short reason
- **Status updates** appear on the relevant issue, not in a separate
  channel

## What not to do

- Do not open a "discussion"-style issue ("any plans for X?", "would
  you accept a PR that adds Y?") — use Discussions instead
- Do not DM the maintainer for project support — the public channels
  help the next person with the same question
- Do not bump an idle issue with "+1" — it does not raise priority

## Languages

- Issues, PRs, and discussion posts should be in **English**. The maintainer
  reads English natively
- Code comments, commit messages, and most documentation are in English so
  that the public codebase stays single-language. The console UI is bilingual
  (en-US / zh-CN) and can be switched from the floating controls
- Translations of README or docs are welcome as PRs; no separate `*.zh-CN.md`
  is shipped with the project

---

For real-time chat, there is **no Discord / no Telegram / no WeChat
group**. The maintainer does not have the bandwidth to moderate
another channel, and chat archives lose context that issues preserve.
